:::{#def-union}
#### Union

The **union** of sets $A$ and $B$,
written $A \cup B$,
is the set of elements that are in $A$, in $B$, or in both:

$$A \cup B \eqdef \set{x : x \in A \text{ or } x \in B}$$

More generally, the union of sets $A_1, A_2, \ldots$,
written $\bigcup_{i} A_i$,
is the set of elements that are in at least one $A_i$.

:::
